[P2] Preserve fatal failures independently of task cancellation

Without plugins, `completion` is the cancellable `ExecutorTaskHandle.completion()`. If the runtime caller is interrupted while result serialization runs, cleanup cancels that future. A serializer that cooperatively exits by throwing an `InternalError` then has its failure discarded by `ExecutorTaskHandle.run()` because cancellation already won publication. Even after cleanup observes actual worker exit, this check sees only `CancellationException` and returns the lifecycle interruption instead of the fatal. Retain an uncancelled lifecycle outcome or separate fatal record, and test cancellation during serialization without plugins.
